title: Stalks of filtered colimits of sheaves of modules are filtered colimits of stalks
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $x\in X$, $\mathcal I$ a small filtered category [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], and $D:\mathcal I\to\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$ a diagram of sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. If $(\mathcal F,(c_i:D(i)\to\mathcal F)_i)$ is a colimit of $D$ in $\Mod(\mathcal O_X)$, then, for the ordinary Zariski module stalks [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk], the compatible maps $(c_i)_x:D(i)_x\to\mathcal F_x$ exhibit $\mathcal F_x$ as the colimit of the diagram $i\mapsto D(i)_x$; equivalently, the canonical map $\varinjlim_iD(i)_x\to\mathcal F_x$ is an isomorphism.
